title: Design System: Music Trivia - Liquid Glass

display.purpose: Hero headlines, victory banners, round announcements.

label.purpose: Countdown timers, leaderboards, scores, hotkey keycaps.

shadows.name: glass-outer
shadows.purpose: Elevation for floating glass surfaces over dark ambient background.

shadows.name: glow-primary
shadows.purpose: Active focus, streak multipliers, and correct answer feedback glow.

motion.name: ease-fluid
motion.purpose: Snappy smooth curve for liquid glass layout transitions.

motion.name: spring-snappy
motion.purpose: Haptic button scale and answer selection bounce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary high-contrast CTA with amber glow and active tactile scale.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.82 0.17 75); color: oklch(0.18 0.03 75); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 20px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px oklch(0.82 0.17 75 / 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 6px 28px oklch(0.82 0.17 75 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.82 0.17 75); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Liquid Glass Surface
components.description: Floating liquid glass container with specular top sheen, noise grain, and outer shadow.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.06); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(160%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.14); border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); color: oklch(0.97 0.004 270); } .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-family: monospace; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.82 0.17 75 / 0.15); color: oklch(0.82 0.17 75); margin-bottom: 12px; }

components.name: Trivia Answer Option
components.description: Tactile answer option with keycap indicator and hover highlight.
components.css: .ds-answer-option { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.06); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.14); border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px 20px; min-height: 60px; color: oklch(0.97 0.004 270); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; text-align: left; } .ds-answer-option:hover { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.12); border-color: oklch(0.82 0.17 75 / 0.5); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-keycap { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.82 0.17 75); flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview: Music Trivia treats music as the hero in a warm, tactile, dimly lit listening lounge. The interface lives on an ambient field of soft drifting color orbs and fine microscopic grain. The chrome—floating navigation dock, countdown timer ring, answer cards, and dialogs—is rendered in floating liquid glass with specular sheens, subtle edge highlights, and Chromium SVG refraction.
keyCharacteristics: Atmospheric Living Backdrop with pre-blurred drifting orbs and subtle audio-reactive burst
Three-Tier Liquid Glass with specular pointer sheen, SVG noise, and accessibility fallbacks
Typographic Gravity: Unbounded display headlines paired with Inter body and JetBrains Mono tabular figures
One Primary Action per viewport with <100ms response time and skippable animations

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Primary amber or accent color is reserved for the single actionable target per viewport. It never coats passive cards or static banners.

rules.name: The No-Flash Rule
rules.body: Theme switches use the circular View Transitions API from the trigger element or instant inline script execution to eliminate white flashes on page reload.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every countdown timer, scoreboard score, and percentage must use monospace tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) to prevent horizontal layout jank during ticking.

rules.name: The Max-Three Glass Rule
rules.body: No more than 3 glass surfaces may ever be stacked vertically in a single viewport. Deep nested cards are prohibited.

dos: Do maintain instant feedback (<100ms) on all trivia clicks before triggering socket transitions.
Do support keyboard shortcuts 1–4 and A–D for all question screens.
Do test every color against worst-case transparent backdrops for WCAG AA compliance.
Do pause all 3D canvas requestAnimationFrame loops and ambient orb animations when document.hidden is true.
donts: Don't use colored side-tab borders (border-l-4), nested cards, or eyebrow chips.
Don't use purple-to-pink generic gradients or neon cyan ink on dark grounds.
Don't animate backdrop-filter: blur() values dynamically (causes heavy GPU frame drops).
Don't use generic CTAs like 'Get Started' or 'Click Here'; use music-specific verbs like 'Start a round', 'Join room', 'Submit guess'.
